about: What a packaged Row-Bot runtime leaves out, and which bytecode it ships. Applied by src/row_bot/payload_trim.py in installer/build_installer.ps1, installer/build_mac_app.sh and installer/build_linux_app.sh. .dist-info folders are never touched: RECORD and METADATA let pip uninstall a library in an update, and licence files stay with the library they cover.

test_directories.why: Libraries' own test suites and their data (a few also trip macOS notarization). Folders named testing stay: numpy.testing and torch.testing are imported at run time.

keep.why: numpy/testing/_private/utils.py imports it when numpy.testing is imported, which scipy, scikit-learn and the embedding stack do.

remove.why: C++ headers, used only to compile PyTorch extensions or torch.compile code; Row-Bot does neither. About 9,300 files.
CMake files for building against PyTorch.

remove_suffixes.why: Import and static libraries and debug symbols, used only to link against a library or to debug it; Python never loads them.

remove_directory_suffixes.why: Debug-symbol bundles (PyObjC's test suite ships them); never loaded.

discovery_documents.why: The Google API client describes each Google API with a bundled JSON document (about 580 of them). Row-Bot builds only Gmail v1 (tools/gmail_tool.py) and Calendar v3 (tools/calendar_tool.py).

scripts.why: Console-script launchers pip writes into python/Scripts (Windows) or python/bin, as listed in each library's RECORD. Row-Bot runs libraries as modules (python -m ...) and never these launchers, and on Windows they embed the build time. The interpreter itself is not in any RECORD and stays.

stdlib.why: The standard library's own test suite (and ensurepip, as the macOS and Linux builds always did).

bytecode.why: Version folders are never written after install (updates share them through hard links) and the launchers set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, so a module without shipped bytecode is compiled in memory each time a process imports it. Compiling every library added about 32,000 files; most of them are never imported.
bytecode.rule: Deterministic bytecode (compileall -s <version root> --invalidation-mode unchecked-hash) for every Python file under app/, and for every Python file under python/ that the bundled interpreter imports while it runs the runtime check below with a throwaway data folder. Nothing else ships bytecode.
